newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK paper prices up, interbank market trade slow.
newsitem.headline: HK paper prices up, interbank market trade slow.

text.p: Hong Kong government paper prices rose Tuesday as players appeared to have factored in a hike in U.S. interest rates, dealers said.
The seven-year Exchange Fund note yielded 7.80 percent versus 7.85 at midday Monday, five-year yielded 7.40 against 7.50 and three-year 6.80 versus 6.87.

In the interbank market, many banks squared positions and refrained from taking new ones ahead of Friday's U.S. payroll data. Overnight traded at 5-3/8 percent against 5-7/15 3/8 and three-month was at 5-13/16 3/4 versus 5-8/19 19/32 percent.
